Edits: none. The archived bytes are uploaded unchanged. A landscape copy is [[:File:Tat-L-tatooineslavequarters-decipher-archive-rotated.jpg]].

The Holotable face [[:File:Tat-L-tatooineslavequarters.gif]] is a separate file and is not replaced by this file.
